title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Full-Stack AI Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: , Redux, Mui, -query, -table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization

title: Banco de Talentos: Consultor de Implementação ITSM
description:
Sobre a Bravo Solutions


A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que visam transformar a experiência do cliente. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que permitam aos nossos clientes otimizar seus processos e alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos buscando perfis para o nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em consultoria técnica. Este profissional será o responsável por dar vida às soluções, atuando tanto na configuração de novos projetos (implementação) quanto no atendimento especializado para garantir a continuidade e evolução das ferramentas nos nossos clientes.


⚠️ Atenção ao Perfil: Esta é uma posição de cunho técnico e operacional . Buscamos profissionais que gostam de configurar sistemas, desenhar fluxos lógicos e resolver problemas de software. Se o seu perfil é focado exclusivamente em Customer Success (CS) comercial, gestão de contas ou métricas de retenção, esta vaga não se adequa às suas atividades diárias.
O que você fará por aqui:

Buscamos um Consultor versátil para atuar em duas frentes principais:

  • Implementação e Projetos: Analisar os processos do cliente e realizar a configuração técnica (parametrização ) das ferramentas Freshworks e similares. Criar fluxos de automação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e portais de autoatendimento.
  • Consultoria de Suporte: Atendimento especializado de tickets de média e alta complexidade, realizando diagnósticos de causa raiz e ajustes de configuração para garantir o sucesso da solução.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Conduzir sessões consultivas para ensinar usuários e administradores a utilizarem as funcionalidades técnicas configuradas.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):
  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência prévia com implementação de sistemas, suporte técnico especializado ou consultoria de software SaaS.
  • Lógica de Sistemas: Capacidade de traduzir processos de negócio em regras lógicas dentro do software (Ex: \"If/Then\" logic, automações e triggers).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas: Familiaridade com softwares de ITSM, Helpdesk ou CRM (Freshservice, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em Processos: Fundamentos de ITIL , Gestão de Serviços ou Governança de TI.
  • Formação: Graduação concluída ou cursando em TI, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Administração de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais:
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Scrum ou Kanban para organização de fluxos de trabalho e entregas.
  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações e interação com parceiros globais.


Informações Gerais:
  • Modelo de Contratação: Possibilidade de contratação via CLT ou PJ.


Por que entrar para o nosso banco?

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil será avaliado para futuras oportunidades em nossos times de Serviços Profissionais (Projetos) ou Suporte Especializado , permitindo que você atue em um ambiente de tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

title: Analista de empréstimo
description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.



What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.


What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.



What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Benefits:
  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

COME MAKE HISTORY WITH US.

WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER!

description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.



What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.


What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.



What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Benefits:
  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

COME MAKE HISTORY WITH US.

WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER!

title: Fullstack Developer (Node.js + React + AWS)
description:
About You

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • 7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Proven experience building full-stack applications using React and TypeScript . Experience with modern React state management patterns.
  • Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or GraphQL APIs .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments.
  • Strong experience with DynamoDB in production environments, including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling.
  • Experience supporting hybrid architectures , including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or other IaC tools (CloudFormation, Terraform)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions).
  • Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using CloudWatch or similar tools.
  • Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
  • Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Develop and operate high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
  • Model and optimize data access patterns in DynamoDB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
  • Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
  • Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.
  • Experience designing and operating REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus).
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures in production environments.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;

  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills

title: Founder Associate (Growth)
description:
Location: Brazil (remote-first, with collaboration across Europe & Latin America)

Languages: English (fluent), Portuguese (fluent), Spanish (plus)


About OpenHealth

OpenHealth is building the infrastructure layer for health data , harmonizing and enriching laboratory results to power clinics, labs, insurers, and health-tech companies across Europe and Latin America. Our mission is to unlock the full value of medical data to enable better clinical decisions, preventive care, and AI-driven health innovation.

In 2025 OpenHealth raised it’s second institutional investment round, invested by selected leading Venture Capital firms from Europe:


What You Will Do

As Founder Associate , you will work directly with our CEO and act as a force multiplier across strategy, growth, project execution, operations, and fundraising . You will take full ownership of strategic initiatives , from definition to execution, and ensure that the most important projects move fast and deliver impact.

On a typical day, you may:

  • Lead high-impact strategic projects end-to-end with full ownership, such as new market entries, launch of new products, or strategic partnerships
  • Own project management for cross-functional initiatives, including scoping, timelines, stakeholder alignment, execution tracking, and delivery
  • Drive cross-functional programs across product, tech, growth, operations, and external partners
  • Support enterprise clients and strategic partners , including preparation of proposals, business cases, and pilots
  • Prepare board- and investor-ready presentations, decision memos, KPIs, and performance reports
  • Conduct market, competitor, customer, and investor research to support strategic decisions and positioning
  • Improve and scale internal processes and workflows , leveraging automation and AI where possible
  • Support fundraising and investor relations , including pitch materials, data rooms, investor outreach, and follow-ups
  • Act as a sparring partner to the CEO , helping prioritize initiatives, challenge assumptions, and execute across multiple workstreams simultaneously


Who You Are

You are a high-ownership, execution-focused strategic generalist who enjoys operating close to decision-making and turning strategy into results.

Your profile likely includes:

  • A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Medicine , or a similarly analytical field
  • 1–3 years of high-impact professional experience , e.g. in management consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, Big Tech, health-tech, or an early-stage venture-backed startup
  • Demonstrated experience in project management , owning complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders from planning to execution
  • A clear track record of leading strategic projects under full ownership , such as new market entries, international expansion, or go-to-market initiatives
  • Strong analytical and structured thinking , with the ability to turn complex problems into clear, actionable plans
  • Proven ability to work directly with C-level executives , driving initiatives with measurable impact
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability – you proactively identify problems and deliver solutions
  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-pressure environments with shifting priorities
  • Known for being reliable, persistent, and outcome-driven , with a strong bias toward execution


What Matters to Us

  • Strong motivation for the health industry , ideally with first exposure to healthcare, health-tech, life sciences, or medical data
  • Interest in how technology, data, and AI can meaningfully improve healthcare systems and patient outcomes
  • Ability to communicate effectively across business, technical, and medical stakeholders
  • A mindset of ownership, learning, and long-term impact


Languages & Location

  • English: Fluent
  • Portuguese: Fluent
  • Spanish: Plus / nice to have
  • Location: Brazil - São Paulo or Florianopolis (working closely with teams and partners in Europe & Latin America)


Why Join OpenHealth?

  • Work directly with the founders on company-defining initiatives
  • Take full ownership of strategic projects with visible impact
  • Exposure to international markets, enterprise clients, and investors
  • Steep learning curve across health-tech, data, AI, and B2B SaaS
  • Clear growth path into senior strategy, operations, or leadership roles

title: Analista de desenvolvimento de software SR
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

O dia a dia:

  • Disseminar conhecimento e documentar decisões técnicas, por meio da criação de documentos ou registros no sistema de gestão.
  • Promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código e testes automatizados, por meio de capacitações, compartilhamento de informações e registros.
  • Identificar e remover bloqueios que impactem as entregas do time.
  • Realizar revisão de código e de decisões técnicas, garantindo estabilidade, qualidade e aderência aos padrões da empresa.
  • Contribuir com os Coordenadores de Produto na definição de roadmap e na estratégia do time, considerando aspectos técnicos.
  • Apoiar outros times de Engenharia, garantindo que grandes lançamentos e mudanças tecnológicas ocorram de forma segura, minimizando impactos.
  • Participar da definição de projetos e tarefas, avaliando arquitetura, impactos, estratégias de deploy e entregáveis.
  • Desenvolver pipelines de Integração Contínua (CI).
  • Estruturar monitoramento, alarmes e ferramentas de troubleshooting.
  • Avaliar trade-offs, riscos e impactos para subsidiar decisões técnicas.
  • Desdobrar projetos complexos em entregas menores, executáveis por si ou pelo time.
  • Trazer visibilidade sobre débitos técnicos e riscos, propondo priorizações para mitigação.
  • Investigar e atuar em incidentes de produção, liderando a análise e correção da causa raiz.
  • Antecipar impactos de mudanças e novos produtos na arquitetura existente, propondo ações de mitigação.
  • Definir, discutir e documentar padrões de código, práticas de qualidade e estratégias de testes.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos de segurança nos sistemas.
  • Apoiar a liderança imediata na análise de problemas e definição de ações, contribuindo para a melhoria dos processos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de normas e procedimentos da área, identificando e sugerindo melhorias.
  • Analisar processos e propor melhorias que contribuam para a eficiência e os resultados da área.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e inovações tecnológicas, promovendo a melhoria contínua.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme orientação da liderança.


Requisitos e qualificações

Para essa posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência prática com Datadog para monitoramento de aplicações, análise de logs e construção de dashboards.
  • Conhecimento em OpenTelemetry para instrumentação de serviços e geração de métricas, traces e logs.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade em ambientes distribuídos, como definição de SLOs, criação de alertas, análise de causa raiz e correlação de eventos.
  • Vivência com arquitetura baseada em microsserviços, uso de mensageria (como Kafka ou RabbitMQ) e integração com sistemas legados ou de terceiros.
  • Capacidade de desenhar soluções escaláveis, resilientes e observáveis.
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript e Node.js no desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços backend.
  • Proficiência no uso do framework NestJS, incluindo conceitos como injeção de dependência, interceptors, pipes, guards e modules.
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs REST, seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e segurança.


Informações adicionais

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Engenheiro de dados - Azure
description:
Código da vaga:57303


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Responsabilidades:

Experiência atuando com ferramentas Microsoft, com foco em Cloud Azure.

Experiência em computação em nuvem, especialmente com Databricks e Azure Data Factory. Habilidade para manipular e extrair insights de grandes conjuntos de dados.

Suporte, manutenção e criação de pipelines/ETLs.

Linguagens: Python, SQL, PySpark.

Prompt AI, Power BI e Airflow .

Responsabilidades Diárias: Aplicar conhecimento em arquitetura de dados e como aplicá-la. Implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados.

Desenvolver, otimizar e gerenciar pipelines de dados e ETLs.

Implementar mecanismos de segurança para acesso aos dados.

Monitorar a execução dos sistemas e das pipelines.

Elaborar soluções de dados completas para os clientes.

Inglês avançado


CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Software (TypeScript/Ruby/React) Engineer
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape and scale a modern web experience for a fast-paced, consumer-facing product team. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver elegant, performant, and maintainable applications using TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and React . This role is ideal for someone who possesses a high level of agency, a \"doer\" mentality, and the ability to maintain a full product vision while shipping high-quality code at speed.


Core Requirements :

  • Mastery of TypeScript and React for building complex, scalable web applications.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development with a proven track record of shipping production-grade software.
  • Experience working with Ruby on Rails (or interest in a product where RoR is core)
  • Prior experience in the Trading, Brokerage, or Wealth Management industries.
  • Demonstrated high level of agency and a proactive \"doer\" mentality, with the ability to hit the ground running and own features end-to-end.
  • Strong product sense and the ability to build for the long term while balancing immediate delivery needs.
  • Excellent understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with unit testing and a commitment to maintaining high code quality through thoughtful testing practices.
  • Comfort navigating fast-paced environments and collaborating within cross-functional agile teams.
  • Strong eye for design-to-dev fidelity and a passion for creating fluid, responsive user interfaces.


Nice to Have :

  • Full-stack development experience or a strong understanding of backend systems and API design.
  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs and modern data-fetching libraries.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for web applications.
  • Exposure to modern CSS-in-JS libraries or advanced styling frameworks.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community, fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career - we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Application Support- Dynatrace (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing:

  • Providing application support and monitoring using Dynatrace;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Linux-based environments;
  • Ensuring observability and performance optimization of applications;
  • Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to enhance system reliability;
  • Writing and executing SQL queries for data analysis and issue resolution;
  • Establishing best practices for application performance and monitoring;



What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Application Support, with at least 3 years of Dynatrace experience;
  • Experience with Linux environments;
  • SQL knowledge (other database experience is also considered);
  • Experience in Observability/Monitoring tools (Dynatrace preferred);
  • Java knowledge is a plus;
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Hybrid work model: available to work in Porto or Lisbon;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate (from Brazil to Portuga l).



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Vaga | Senior Data Engineer / BI Engineer – Microsoft Stack (SSRS Mandatório)


Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Data Engineer / BI Engineer para atuar na engenharia, modelagem e disponibilização de dados corporativos, com forte foco em Microsoft SQL Server e SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).


Essa é uma posição estratégica, voltada para ambientes corporativos críticos, responsável por relatórios oficiais, operacionais e gerenciais, com atuação próxima a times de backend e áreas de negócio.


Inglês fluente é mandatório.


Responsabilidades


Projetar, desenvolver e manter modelos de dados relacionais e dimensionais (Data Warehouse / Data Marts).


Desenvolver, otimizar e manter stored procedures, views, funções e queries complexas em SQL Server (T-SQL).


Atuar fortemente em performance tuning (índices, execution plans, concorrência).


Desenvolver e manter relatórios corporativos em SSRS, incluindo:


Relatórios paginados


Sub-relatórios


Parâmetros dinâmicos


Expressions e formatações avançadas


Construir e manter pipelines de dados (ETL) para carga, transformação e consolidação.


Garantir qualidade, consistência, integridade e governança dos dados.


Atuar em parceria com times de backend, entendendo integrações, APIs e fluxos de dados.


Apoiar áreas de negócio na definição de métricas, indicadores e modelos de informação.


Documentar modelos, relatórios e fluxos de dados.


✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios


SQL Server & Data Modeling


Experiência sólida com Microsoft SQL Server.


Domínio de T-SQL avançado.


Forte experiência em modelagem de dados:


Modelagem relacional


Modelagem dimensional (Star Schema / Snowflake)


Fatos, dimensões e histórico (SCD)


SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)


Experiência obrigatória e comprovada com SSRS.


Criação e manutenção de:


Relatórios paginados


Sub-relatórios


Parâmetros e filtros complexos


Expressions avançadas


Conhecimento em performance, segurança e deploy de relatórios SSRS.


ETL & Integrações


Experiência com ETL / pipelines de dados (preferencialmente SSIS ou equivalente).


Vivência com cargas incrementais, reprocessamentos e tratamento de falhas.


Backend Microsoft


Experiência com tecnologias Microsoft, como:


NET / C# (leitura, manutenção ou desenvolvimento básico)


Integrações de aplicações com SQL Server


Jobs, serviços e processos batch


Capacidade de atuar integrado a times de backend.


Experiência


Perfil Sênior.


Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e estruturados.


Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais


Experiência com Azure (Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, App Services).


Conhecimento em Power BI como camada de consumo.


Vivência em Shared Services ou grandes estruturas corporativas.


Experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, indústria, saúde, logística).


Como se candidatar

Envie seu CV para


Assunto do e-mail: Engenheiro de Dados

description:

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

description:

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.

  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Android Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

description:

• Abertura e cadastro de casos novos;

• Solicitação de cadastramento de clientes/documentos;

• Acompanhamento dos prazos administrativos;

• Gestão de ferramentas jurídicas;

• Preenchimento de formulários;

• Geração de guias e petições eletrônicas;

• Elaboração de peças administrativas e seu protocolamento;

• Análise de contratos;

• Apoio à elaboração de documentos legais. Auxilia na redação e organização de petições, contratos, relatórios, pareceres e outros documentos jurídicos.

• Envio de e-mails periódicos;

• Elaboração de relatórios/pareceres para clientes;

Execução de outras atividades correlatas à função, que possam surgir no decorrer das operações, demonstrando flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com diversas demandas.

• Bacharel em Direito ou cursando a partir do 4º semestre;

• Experiência com sistemas de gestão jurídica

• Capacidade de lidar com situações de estresse e pressão, especialmente ao lidar diretamente com os clientes.

• Demonstração de responsabilidade extrema no cumprimento das tarefas atribuídas.

• Proficiência excepcional na língua portuguesa, tanto na comunicação verbal quanto na escrita.

• Habilidade organizacional para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e garantir a eficiência operacional.


Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência prévia no ramo da propriedade industrial.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Vaga | Senior Data Engineer / BI Engineer – Microsoft Stack (SSRS Mandatório)


Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Data Engineer / BI Engineer para atuar na engenharia, modelagem e disponibilização de dados corporativos, com forte foco em Microsoft SQL Server e SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).


Essa é uma posição estratégica, voltada para ambientes corporativos críticos, responsável por relatórios oficiais, operacionais e gerenciais, com atuação próxima a times de backend e áreas de negócio.


Inglês fluente é mandatório.


Responsabilidades


Projetar, desenvolver e manter modelos de dados relacionais e dimensionais (Data Warehouse / Data Marts).


Desenvolver, otimizar e manter stored procedures, views, funções e queries complexas em SQL Server (T-SQL).


Atuar fortemente em performance tuning (índices, execution plans, concorrência).


Desenvolver e manter relatórios corporativos em SSRS, incluindo:


Relatórios paginados


Sub-relatórios


Parâmetros dinâmicos


Expressions e formatações avançadas


Construir e manter pipelines de dados (ETL) para carga, transformação e consolidação.


Garantir qualidade, consistência, integridade e governança dos dados.


Atuar em parceria com times de backend, entendendo integrações, APIs e fluxos de dados.


Apoiar áreas de negócio na definição de métricas, indicadores e modelos de informação.


Documentar modelos, relatórios e fluxos de dados.


✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios


SQL Server & Data Modeling


Experiência sólida com Microsoft SQL Server.


Domínio de T-SQL avançado.


Forte experiência em modelagem de dados:


Modelagem relacional


Modelagem dimensional (Star Schema / Snowflake)


Fatos, dimensões e histórico (SCD)


SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)


Experiência obrigatória e comprovada com SSRS.


Criação e manutenção de:


Relatórios paginados


Sub-relatórios


Parâmetros e filtros complexos


Expressions avançadas


Conhecimento em performance, segurança e deploy de relatórios SSRS.


ETL & Integrações


Experiência com ETL / pipelines de dados (preferencialmente SSIS ou equivalente).


Vivência com cargas incrementais, reprocessamentos e tratamento de falhas.


Backend Microsoft


Experiência com tecnologias Microsoft, como:


NET / C# (leitura, manutenção ou desenvolvimento básico)


Integrações de aplicações com SQL Server


Jobs, serviços e processos batch


Capacidade de atuar integrado a times de backend.


Experiência


Perfil Sênior.


Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e estruturados.


Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais


Experiência com Azure (Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, App Services).


Conhecimento em Power BI como camada de consumo.


Vivência em Shared Services ou grandes estruturas corporativas.


Experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, indústria, saúde, logística).


Como se candidatar

Envie seu CV para

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.
